mapper.sql: task_id, interaction_id, customer_id, operating_case_id, task_type, title, description, status, priority, assigned_to, assigned_role, due_date, completed_date, tags, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( task_id, interaction_id, customer_id, operating_case_id, task_type, title, description, status, priority, assigned_to, assigned_role, due_date, completed_date, tags, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{interactionId}, #{customerId}, #{operatingCaseId}, #{taskType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assignedTo}, #{assignedRole}, #{dueDate}, #{completedDate}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{parentTaskId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE interaction_id = #{interactionId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task WHERE operating_case_id = #{operatingCaseId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task WHERE assigned_to = #{assignedTo} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task WHERE status IN ('TODO','IN_PROGRESS') AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY due_date
SELECT FROM task WHERE parent_task_id = #{parentTaskId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT FROM task ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
